2608.18731.title: A Few Cases Are All You Need: An Empirical Study of Annotation-Efficient LoRA Fine-Tuning of MedSAM3
2608.18731.paper_summary: Medical image segmentation is essential for clinical workflows such as treatment planning and disease assessment. While specialist tools like TotalSegmentator and MRSegmentator achieve strong performance, they require large annotated datasets for training. Medical foundation models offer a promising alternative through large-scale pretraining that reduces the annotation burden for new tasks, but zero-shot performance remains limited. Parameter-efficient adaptation via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient specialization with few trainable parameters, but a key question remains: how many expert-annotated cases are needed to achieve clinically useful segmentation performance? We address this by adapting MedSAM3 with LoRA for five abdominal organs (liver, kidneys, spleen, gallbladder, and pancreas) in CT and MRI using only 1, 2, 5, and 10 annotated cases, evaluating on AMOS22 dataset. With just 10 cases, models achieve performance competitive with specialist systems trained on orders of magnitude more data. Notably, this includes reliable gallbladder segmentation (Dice 0.68 CT, 0.59 MRI) where existing tools fail almost completely (Dice 0.0004), while remaining within 5--10% of MRSegmentator for liver, kidneys, and spleen using over 100 times fewer annotations. Furthermore, external validation on the Whole Heart Segmentation dataset shows that the approach extends to cardiac segmentation, a use case beyond the scope of TotalSegmentator (MRI) and MRSegmentator, achieving competitive left ventricle (LV) performance with only 10 annotated cases. Training requires only3--5,hours per organ on a single GPU, approximately 2--3 times faster than nnU-Net. These findings suggest that ten annotated cases are sufficient for clinically useful segmentation, effectively reducing bottlenecks for both image annotation and training time.
2608.18731.paper_summary_zh: 醫學影像分割對於臨床工作流程如治療計劃和疾病評估至關重要。雖然像 TotalSegmentator 和 MRSegmentator 這樣的專業工具表現出色，但它們需要大量標註數據集進行訓練。醫學基礎模型通過大規模預訓練提供了一個有前景的替代方案，減輕了新任務的標註負擔，但零樣本性能仍然有限。通過低秩適應（LoRA）的參數高效適應使得在很少的可訓練參數下實現高效專業化，但一個關鍵問題仍然存在：需要多少專家標註的案例才能達到臨床有用的分割性能？我們通過使用僅 1、2、5 和 10 個標註案例，將 MedSAM3 與 LoRA 調整為五個腹部器官（肝臟、腎臟、脾臟、膽囊和胰臟）在 CT 和 MRI 中進行評估，並在 AMOS22 數據集上進行評估。僅用 10 個案例，模型的性能可與在數量級上更多數據上訓練的專業系統相媲美。值得注意的是，這包括可靠的膽囊分割（Dice 0.68 CT，0.59 MRI），而現有工具幾乎完全失敗（Dice 0.0004），同時在使用超過 100 倍更少標註的情況下，對於肝臟、腎臟和脾臟的性能仍然在 MRSegmentator 的 5--10% 之內。此外，對 Whole Heart Segmentation 數據集的外部驗證顯示，該方法擴展到心臟分割，這是一個超出 TotalSegmentator（MRI）和 MRSegmentator 範疇的用例，僅用 10 個標註案例即可實現具有競爭力的左心室（LV）性能。訓練僅需在單個 GPU 上 3--5 小時每個器官，約比 nnU-Net 快 2--3 倍。這些發現表明，十個標註案例對於臨床有用的分割是足夠的，有效減少了影像標註和訓練時間的瓶頸。
